overall_notes: The paper presents a comprehensive evaluation of LLMs in journalistic interview settings. The extraction was generally accurate but needed consolidation of dataset names, normalization of model/metric names, and clarification of what constitutes true automatic metrics vs. LLM-as-judge criteria. The paper uses both automatic metrics (information extraction reward) and LLM-as-judge evaluation (consistency analysis) to assess generated outputs.
